lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity white spots are arranged in roughly horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits. The spots in the mid-flank region are larger and more widely spaced than those near the dorsal ridge.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of lighter pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, creating a subtle grid-like pattern on the upper-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A sharp horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a highlight on its dorsal edge and a shadow on its ventral edge, extending from the gill region towards the posterior.

other_distinctive_markers: Five dark, vertical branchial slits are highly visible on the anterior flank.
